decisions.choice: being afraid: fear is the reason he gives
decisions.reason: The slave says fear of the master kept him from using the money.

decisions.choice: you have what is yours: he gives back exactly what he was given
decisions.reason: He returns the talent untouched and thinks that is enough.

decisions.choice: Here it is (B); Here is (R)
decisions.reason: The slave holds out the money, and Balanced and Readable say so in the way people hand something over.

decisions.choice: "보십시오, 주인님의 것이 여기 있습니다" (L)
decisions.reason: Korean does not say "you have what is yours" when handing something back; it says "here is yours", which keeps the sense that he returns exactly what he was given (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "さあ、どうぞ" (B); "さあ……お返しします" (R)
decisions.reason: The slave holds out the money (m2), and Balanced and Readable say so in the way people hand something over, as the English does.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Πονηρὲ δοῦλε καὶ ὀκνηρέ, ᾔδεις ὅτι θερίζω ὅπου οὐκ ἔσπειρα καὶ συνάγω ὅθεν οὐ διεσκόρπισα;

records.literal_gloss: Answering now the master of him said to him: Wicked slave and lazy, you knew that I reap where not I sowed and gather from where not I scattered?

en.L: But his master answered and said to him, 'Wicked and lazy slave! You knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather from where I did not scatter?
en.B: His master replied, 'You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather where I did not scatter?
en.R: His master answered, 'You are an evil and lazy servant! You say you knew that I harvest where I did not plant and gather where I did not scatter seed.

es.L: Y respondiendo su señor, le dijo: “¡Esclavo malo y perezoso! ¿Sabías que cosecho donde no sembré y recojo de donde no esparcí?
es.B: Su señor le respondió: “¡Siervo malvado y perezoso! ¿Así que sabías que cosecho donde no sembré y recojo donde no esparcí?
es.R: Su señor le contestó: “¡Eres un siervo malo y perezoso! Dices que sabías que cosecho donde no planté y recojo donde no esparcí semilla.

fr.L: Mais son maître, répondant, lui a dit : “Esclave mauvais et paresseux ! Tu savais que je moissonne là où je n’ai pas semé et que je rassemble là où je n’ai pas dispersé ?
fr.B: Son maître lui a répondu : “Serviteur mauvais et paresseux ! Ainsi, tu savais que je moissonne là où je n’ai pas semé et que je ramasse là où je n’ai pas répandu ?
fr.R: Son maître lui a répondu : “Tu es un serviteur méchant et paresseux ! Tu dis que tu savais que je récolte là où je n’ai pas planté, et que je ramasse là où je n’ai pas semé.

sw.L: Lakini bwana wake akajibu, akamwambia, 'Mtumwa mwovu na mvivu! Ulijua kwamba ninavuna mahali nisipopanda na kukusanya mahali nisipotawanya?
sw.B: Bwana wake akamjibu, 'Wewe mtumishi mwovu na mvivu! Kumbe ulijua kwamba ninavuna mahali nisipopanda na kukusanya mahali nisipotawanya?
sw.R: Bwana wake akamjibu, 'Wewe ni mtumishi mbaya na mvivu! Unasema ulijua kwamba ninavuna mahali nisipopanda, na kukusanya mahali nisipotawanya mbegu.

vi.L: Nhưng chủ đáp lời và nói với người ấy: 'Hỡi nô lệ gian ác và biếng nhác! Ngươi biết rằng ta gặt chỗ ta không gieo và thu nhặt chỗ ta không rải sao?
vi.B: Chủ đáp: 'Hỡi đầy tớ gian ác và biếng nhác kia! Vậy ra ngươi biết ta gặt chỗ ta không gieo, thu chỗ ta không rải sao?
vi.R: Ông chủ trả lời: 'Ngươi là đầy tớ gian ác và lười biếng! Ngươi nói ngươi biết ta thu hoạch ở chỗ ta không trồng, và thu gom ở chỗ ta không gieo hạt.

ko.L: 그러자 그의 주인이 대답하여 그에게 말했다. '악하고 게으른 종아! 너는 내가 심지 않은 곳에서 거두고 흩지 않은 곳에서 모으는 줄 알았느냐?
ko.B: 주인이 대답했다. '이 악하고 게으른 종아! 그래, 내가 심지 않은 곳에서 거두고 흩지 않은 곳에서 모으는 줄 알았다는 말이냐?
ko.R: 주인이 대답했다. '너는 악하고 게으른 종이다! 너는 내가 심지 않은 곳에서 거두고, 씨를 뿌리지 않은 곳에서 모은다는 것을 알았다고 말하는구나.

pt.L: Mas o seu senhor, respondendo, lhe disse: 'Escravo mau e preguiçoso! Você sabia que colho onde não semeei e ajunto onde não espalhei?
pt.B: O senhor dele respondeu: 'Servo mau e preguiçoso! Então você sabia que eu colho onde não semeei e recolho onde não espalhei?
pt.R: O senhor respondeu: 'Você é um servo mau e preguiçoso! Você diz que sabia que eu colho onde não plantei e recolho onde não espalhei sementes.

am.L: ጌታውም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው፦ “አንተ ክፉና ሰነፍ ባሪያ! ባልዘራሁበት እንደማጭድ፣ ባልበተንኩበትም እንደምሰበስብ ታውቅ ነበር?
am.B: ጌታውም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት፦ “አንተ ክፉና ሰነፍ ባሪያ! ታዲያ ባልዘራሁበት እንደማጭድ፣ ባልበተንኩበትም እንደምሰበስብ ታውቅ ነበር?
am.R: ጌታውም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት፦ “አንተ ክፉና ሰነፍ ባሪያ ነህ! ባልተከልኩበት እንደማጭድ፣ ዘር ባልበተንኩበትም እንደምሰበስብ ታውቅ ነበር ትላለህ።

ru.L: Господин же его в ответ сказал ему: “Злой и ленивый раб! Ты знал, что я жну, где не сеял, и собираю, где не рассыпал?
ru.B: Господин ответил ему: “Злой, ленивый раб! Значит, ты знал, что я жну там, где не сеял, и собираю там, где не разбрасывал?
ru.R: Господин ответил: “Ты злой и ленивый раб! Ты говоришь, что знал: я собираю урожай там, где не сеял, и собираю зерно там, где не разбрасывал семян.

hi.L: पर उसके स्वामी ने उत्तर देकर उससे कहा, 'दुष्ट और आलसी दास! तुम जानते थे कि जहाँ मैंने नहीं बोया वहाँ मैं काटता हूँ, और जहाँ मैंने नहीं बिखेरा वहाँ से बटोरता हूँ?
hi.B: उसके स्वामी ने उत्तर दिया, 'अरे दुष्ट और आलसी दास! तो तुम जानते थे कि जहाँ मैंने नहीं बोया, वहाँ मैं काटता हूँ, और जहाँ मैंने नहीं बिखेरा, वहाँ से बटोरता हूँ?
hi.R: उसके स्वामी ने जवाब दिया, 'तुम बुरे और आलसी दास हो! तुम कहते हो कि तुम जानते थे कि जहाँ मैंने बोया नहीं, वहाँ मैं फ़सल काटता हूँ, और जहाँ मैंने बीज नहीं बिखेरा, वहाँ से बटोरता हूँ।

uk.L: А його пан, відповідаючи, сказав йому: “Лихий і лінивий рабе! Ти знав, що я жну, де не сіяв, і збираю, де не розсипав?
uk.B: Господар відповів: “Лихий і лінивий рабе! То ти знав, що я жну, де не сіяв, і збираю, де не розкидав?
uk.R: Господар відповів: “Ти злий і лінивий раб! Ти кажеш, що знав, ніби я збираю врожай там, де не садив, і збираю зерно там, де не розкидав насіння.

ja.L: しかし、主人は答えて彼に言った。『悪い、怠け者の奴隷よ。わたしが蒔かなかった所から刈り取り、散らさなかった所から集めることを、おまえは知っていたのか？
ja.B: 主人は答えた。『悪い、怠け者のしもべだ！わたしが蒔かなかった所から刈り取り、散らさなかった所から集めると、知っていたというのか？
ja.R: 主人は答えた。『おまえは悪くて、怠け者のしもべだ！わたしが植えなかった所から取り入れ、種をまかなかった所から集めることを知っていた、と言うのだな。

decisions.choice: you knew ...: the master repeats the slave's words to judge him by them
alternatives: the master admits he is harsh
decisions.reason: The master does not agree that he is hard. He takes the slave at his word: if he believed it, he should have acted on it (25:27). The sentence may be read as a question or as a statement.

decisions.choice: wicked and lazy: the slave's fault is unwillingness, not inability
decisions.reason: He was given one talent according to his ability (25:15), and did nothing with it.

decisions.choice: You say you knew ... (a statement)
decisions.reason: Readable makes the master's point with a statement.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: "gian ác và biếng nhác" (L, B); "gian ác và lười biếng" (R)
decisions.reason: The fault is unwillingness, not inability (meaning decision); "gian ác" pairs with the "tốt" (good) of 25:21, and Readable uses the everyday word for lazy.

decisions.choice: The master repeats the servant's words in his own plain style, without the honorifics
decisions.reason: The master judges the servant by his own words (meaning decision); in Korean he speaks of himself without honorifics, so the words are the same but the endings are the master's.

decisions.choice: "……知っていた、と言うのだな" (R), a statement
decisions.reason: The sentence may be read as a question or a statement (m1); Readable makes the master's point with a statement, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἔδει σε οὖν βαλεῖν τὰ ἀργύριά μου τοῖς τραπεζίταις, καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐγὼ ἐκομισάμην ἂν τὸ ἐμὸν σὺν τόκῳ.

records.literal_gloss: It behooved you therefore to put the money of me to the bankers, and having come I would have received the my own with interest.

en.L: Then you ought to have put my money with the bankers, and when I came I would have received what is mine with interest.
en.B: In that case you should have handed my money to the bankers. On my return I would at least have got back what is mine, with interest.
en.R: Then you should have put my money in the bank. When I came back, I would at least have gotten it back with some interest.

es.L: Debías, pues, haber puesto mi dinero con los banqueros, y al venir yo habría recibido lo mío con intereses.
es.B: Entonces debiste haber entregado mi dinero a los banqueros. Al volver, por lo menos habría recuperado lo mío con los intereses.
es.R: Entonces debiste poner mi dinero en el banco. Cuando yo volviera, por lo menos lo habría recibido con algo de intereses.

fr.L: Il te fallait donc placer mon argent chez les banquiers, et à mon retour, j’aurais récupéré ce qui est à moi avec un intérêt.
fr.B: Dans ce cas, tu aurais dû confier mon argent aux banquiers. À mon retour, j’aurais au moins récupéré mon bien avec les intérêts.
fr.R: Alors tu aurais dû mettre mon argent à la banque. En revenant, j’aurais au moins pu le reprendre avec un peu d’intérêts.

sw.L: Basi ilikupasa kuweka fedha zangu kwa wabadilishaji fedha, nami nikija ningalipokea kilicho changu pamoja na riba.
sw.B: Basi ingekupasa kuziweka fedha zangu kwa wabadilishaji fedha. Nikirudi, angalau ningepata kilicho changu pamoja na riba.
sw.R: Basi ungeziweka fedha zangu benki. Nikirudi, angalau ningezipata pamoja na riba kidogo.

vi.L: Vậy ngươi lẽ ra phải đưa tiền của ta cho những người đổi bạc, và khi ta đến, ta đã nhận lại của ta cùng với tiền lời.
vi.B: Thế thì ngươi phải gửi tiền của ta cho những người đổi bạc, để khi về, ít ra ta cũng nhận lại được của ta cùng với tiền lời.
vi.R: Vậy ngươi lẽ ra phải gửi tiền của ta vào ngân hàng. Khi ta về, ít ra ta cũng lấy lại được tiền của ta với một ít tiền lời.

ko.L: 그렇다면 너는 내 은돈을 환전상들에게 맡겼어야 했다. 그러면 내가 와서 내 것을 이자와 함께 돌려받았을 것이다.
ko.B: 그렇다면 너는 내 돈을 환전상들에게라도 맡겼어야 했다. 그랬으면 내가 돌아와서 적어도 내 것을 이자와 함께 돌려받았을 것이다.
ko.R: 그렇다면 내 돈을 은행에라도 맡겼어야 했다. 그러면 내가 돌아왔을 때 이자라도 조금 붙여서 돌려받았을 것이다.

pt.L: Então você devia ter posto o meu dinheiro com os banqueiros, e, ao vir, eu teria recebido o que é meu com juros.
pt.B: Nesse caso, você devia ter entregado o meu dinheiro aos banqueiros. Na minha volta, eu teria recebido pelo menos o que é meu, com juros.
pt.R: Então você devia ter colocado o meu dinheiro no banco. Quando eu voltasse, pelo menos receberia o dinheiro de volta com um pouco de juros.

am.L: እንግዲያስ ገንዘቤን ለገንዘብ ለዋጮች ልትሰጥ ይገባህ ነበር፤ እኔም መጥቼ የእኔን ከወለዱ ጋር እቀበል ነበር።
am.B: እንግዲያውስ ገንዘቤን ለገንዘብ ለዋጮች መስጠት ነበረብህ። ስመለስ ቢያንስ የእኔን ከወለድ ጋር እቀበል ነበር።
am.R: ስለዚህ ገንዘቤን በባንክ ማስቀመጥ ነበረብህ። ስመለስ ቢያንስ ገንዘቤን ከጥቂት ወለድ ጋር እወስድ ነበር።

ru.L: Следовало тебе поэтому отдать моё серебро менялам, и, придя, я получил бы своё с процентами.
ru.B: Тогда тебе следовало отдать мои деньги менялам. Вернувшись, я хотя бы получил своё с процентами.
ru.R: Тогда надо было положить мои деньги в банк. Когда я вернулся бы, я хотя бы получил их обратно с процентами.

hi.L: तो तुम्हें मेरा धन साहूकारों को दे देना चाहिए था, और मैं आकर अपना [धन] ब्याज समेत ले लेता।
hi.B: ऐसा था तो तुम्हें मेरा धन साहूकारों के हाथ में दे देना चाहिए था। लौटने पर मुझे कम से कम अपना धन ब्याज समेत वापस मिल जाता।
hi.R: तो तुम्हें मेरा पैसा बैंक में जमा कर देना चाहिए था। जब मैं लौटता, तो मुझे कम से कम अपना पैसा कुछ ब्याज के साथ वापस मिल जाता।

uk.L: Отже, тобі слід було віддати моє срібло міняйлам, і я, прийшовши, отримав би своє з відсотками.
uk.B: Тоді тобі треба було віддати мої гроші міняйлам. Повернувшись, я принаймні отримав би своє з відсотками.
uk.R: Тоді тобі треба було покласти мої гроші в банк. Коли я повернувся б, то принаймні отримав би їх назад із якимись відсотками.

ja.L: それなら、おまえはわたしの銀を両替人たちに預けるべきであった。そうすれば、わたしは来て、自分のものを利息と共に受け取ったであろうに。
ja.B: それなら、わたしのお金を両替商に預けておくべきだった。そうすれば、帰って来たとき、少なくとも自分のものを利息付きで返してもらえたのだ。
ja.R: それなら、わたしのお金を銀行に預けておけばよかったのだ。そうすれば、わたしが帰って来たとき、少なくとも利息を少しつけて返してもらえたのに。

decisions.choice: bankers: money changers and lenders who paid interest on deposits
decisions.reason: The word comes from the tables at which money changers worked (21:12). They took deposits and lent money at interest.

decisions.choice: with interest: the least he could have done
decisions.reason: Putting money with the bankers needed no effort or risk. The slave did not do even that.

decisions.choice: at least
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out that this was the smallest return possible, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: in the bank
decisions.reason: Readable uses the modern equivalent of a banker's deposit.

decisions.choice: wabadilishaji fedha (L, B); benki (R); riba (interest)
decisions.reason: The bankers were money changers who also took deposits and paid interest (meaning decision m1). "Riba" is the word for interest on money; "faida" is any profit, the word used for what the servants earned by trading.

decisions.choice: "những người đổi bạc" (L, B); "ngân hàng" (R)
decisions.reason: Money changers who also took deposits and paid interest (meaning decision); Readable uses the modern word, as the English Readable says "bank".

decisions.choice: "환전상들" (L, B); "은행" (R)
decisions.reason: Money changers who also took deposits and paid interest (meaning decision); Readable says "the bank", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "менялам" (L, B); "в банк" (R)
decisions.reason: "Менялы" is the familiar Russian word for the money changers who also took deposits; Readable uses the modern equivalent, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "両替人たち" (L); "両替商" (B); "銀行" (R)
decisions.reason: The bankers were money changers who took deposits and paid interest (m1). Literal keeps the word of 21:12; Readable uses the modern equivalent, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ἄρατε οὖν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ τὸ τάλαντον καὶ δότε τῷ ἔχοντι τὰ δέκα τάλαντα·

records.literal_gloss: Take therefore from him the talent and give to the one having the ten talents;

en.L: So take the talent from him and give [it] to the one who has the ten talents.
en.B: So take the {{units:bag of silver|talent}} away from him and give it to the servant who has {{units:ten bags|ten talents}}.
en.R: Take the {{units:bag of silver|talent}} away from him. Give it to the servant who has {{units:ten bags|ten talents}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}}, pues, el talento y {{plural_you:dénselo|dádselo}} al que tiene los diez talentos.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:quítenle|quitadle}} {{units:la bolsa de plata|el talento}} y {{plural_you:den|dad}} ese dinero al siervo que tiene {{units:diez bolsas|diez talentos}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} {{units:la bolsa de plata|el talento}}. {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} ese dinero al siervo que tiene {{units:diez bolsas|diez talentos}}.

fr.L: Enlevez-lui donc le talent et donnez[-le] à celui qui a les dix talents.
fr.B: Enlevez-lui donc le {{units:sac d’argent|talent}} et donnez-le au serviteur qui a {{units:dix sacs|dix talents}}.
fr.R: Enlevez-lui le {{units:sac d’argent|talent}}. Donnez-le au serviteur qui a {{units:dix sacs|dix talents}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo chukueni kutoka kwake ile talanta, mkampe yule aliye na talanta kumi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo chukueni {{units:mfuko huo wa fedha|talanta hiyo}} kutoka kwake, mpeni mtumishi mwenye {{units:mifuko kumi|talanta kumi}}.
sw.R: Mnyang'anyeni {{units:mfuko huo wa fedha|talanta hiyo}}. Mpeni mtumishi mwenye {{units:mifuko kumi|talanta kumi}}.

vi.L: Vậy hãy lấy ta-lâng khỏi nó và đưa cho người có mười ta-lâng.
vi.B: Vậy hãy lấy {{units:túi bạc|ta-lâng}} của nó mà đưa cho người có {{units:mười túi|mười ta-lâng}}.
vi.R: Hãy lấy {{units:túi bạc|ta-lâng}} khỏi nó. Đưa cho người đầy tớ có {{units:mười túi|mười ta-lâng}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 그에게서 그 달란트를 빼앗아 열 달란트 가진 사람에게 주어라.
ko.B: 그러니 그에게서 그 {{units:은 한 자루|한 달란트}}를 빼앗아 {{units:은 열 자루|열 달란트}}를 가진 종에게 주어라.
ko.R: 그에게서 그 {{units:은 한 자루|한 달란트}}를 빼앗아라. 그리고 {{units:은 열 자루|열 달란트}}를 가진 종에게 주어라.

pt.L: Portanto, tirem dele o talento e [o] deem ao que tem os dez talentos.
pt.B: Por isso, tirem dele o talento e deem ao servo que tem dez talentos.
pt.R: Tirem dele o {{units:saco de prata|talento}}. Deem ao servo que tem {{units:dez sacos|dez talentos}}.

am.L: እንግዲህ መክሊቱን ከእርሱ ውሰዱ፤ አሥሩ መክሊት ላለውም ስጡት።
am.B: እንግዲህ {{units:የብሩን ከረጢት|መክሊቱን}} ከእርሱ ውሰዱና {{units:አሥር ከረጢት|አሥር መክሊት}} ላለው ባሪያ ስጡት።
am.R: {{units:የብሩን ከረጢት|መክሊቱን}} ከእርሱ ውሰዱ። {{units:አሥር ከረጢት|አሥር መክሊት}} ላለው ባሪያ ስጡት።

ru.L: Возьмите же у него талант и дайте имеющему десять талантов.
ru.B: Заберите у него {{units:мешок серебра|талант}} и отдайте тому, у кого {{units:десять мешков|десять талантов}}.
ru.R: Заберите у него {{units:мешок серебра|талант}}. Отдайте его рабу, у которого {{units:десять мешков|десять талантов}}.

hi.L: इसलिए उससे वह तालन्त ले लो, और जिसके पास दस तालन्त हैं उसे दे दो।
hi.B: इसलिए वह {{units:चाँदी का थैला|तालन्त}} उससे ले लो और उस दास को दे दो जिसके पास {{units:दस थैले|दस तालन्त}} हैं।
hi.R: उससे वह {{units:चाँदी का थैला|तालन्त}} ले लो। उसे उस दास को दे दो जिसके पास {{units:दस थैले|दस तालन्त}} हैं।

uk.L: Тож заберіть у нього талант і дайте [його] тому, хто має десять талантів.
uk.B: Тож заберіть у нього {{units:мішок срібла|талант}} і віддайте рабові, який має {{units:десять мішків|десять талантів}}.
uk.R: Заберіть у нього {{units:мішок срібла|талант}}. Віддайте його рабові, який має {{units:десять мішків|десять талантів}}.

ja.L: だから、その者からそのタラントンを取り上げて、十タラントンを持っている者に与えよ。
ja.B: だから、その{{units:約二十年分の賃金|一タラントン}}をこの者から取り上げて、{{units:約二百年分の賃金|十タラントン}}を持っているしもべに与えなさい。
ja.R: その{{units:約二十年分の賃金|一タラントン}}を、この男から取り上げなさい。そして、{{units:約二百年分の賃金|十タラントン}}を持っているしもべにやりなさい。

decisions.choice: take, give: commands to those standing by
decisions.reason: The verbs are plural. The master speaks to others in the household.

decisions.choice: the ten talents: the first slave's five and the five he gained
decisions.reason: The first slave now holds ten talents.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on the commands (quítenle|quitadle, den|dad)
decisions.reason: The master gives these orders to those standing by (meaning decision m1), so they are plural and take the ustedes / vosotros setting, as in 25:30. "Ese dinero" in Balanced and Readable avoids a pronoun that would have to change gender with the units setting.

decisions.choice: "nó" for the servant, spoken of to those standing by
decisions.reason: The master turns to the bystanders and speaks of the servant with the contemptuous "nó", as the tenants speak of the son in 21:38.

decisions.choice: Plain imperatives "빼앗아", "주어라" to those standing by
decisions.reason: The master gives orders to his attendants (meaning decision) in the plain style.

decisions.choice: tirem, deem
decisions.reason: The commands are plural, spoken to others in the household (m1), so Portuguese uses the "vocês" forms.

source.text: τῷ γὰρ ἔχοντι παντὶ δοθήσεται καὶ περισσευθήσεται· τοῦ δὲ μὴ ἔχοντος καὶ ὃ ἔχει ἀρθήσεται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: To the for having everyone will be given and he will have abundance; of the but not having even what he has will be taken away from him.

en.L: For to everyone who has, [more] will be given, and {{gender:they|he}} will have abundance; but from the one who does not have, even what {{gender:they have|he has}} will be taken away from {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: For everyone who has will be given more, and {{gender:they|he}} will have more than enough. But anyone who has nothing will lose even what {{gender:they have|he has}}.
en.R: People who have something will be given more, and they will have more than they need. But people who have nothing will lose even the little they have.

es.L: Porque a todo el que tiene, [más] se le dará y le sobrará; pero al que no tiene, incluso lo que tiene le será quitado.
es.B: Porque a todo el que tiene se le dará más, y tendrá de sobra. Pero al que no tiene nada, se le quitará hasta lo que tiene.
es.R: A quien tiene algo se le dará más, y tendrá más de lo que necesita. Pero a quien no tiene nada se le quitará hasta lo poco que tiene.

fr.L: Car à quiconque a, il sera donné [davantage], et il sera dans l’abondance ; mais à celui qui n’a pas, même ce qu’il a lui sera enlevé.
fr.B: Car à celui qui a, on donnera davantage, et il aura plus qu’assez. Mais celui qui n’a rien perdra même ce qu’il a.
fr.R: Ceux qui ont quelque chose recevront davantage, et ils auront plus que ce qu’il leur faut. Mais ceux qui n’ont rien perdront même le peu qu’ils ont.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila mwenye nacho atapewa [zaidi], naye atakuwa na ziada; lakini asiye nacho, hata kile alicho nacho kitaondolewa kwake.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila aliye na kitu atapewa zaidi, naye atakuwa na zaidi ya kutosha. Lakini asiye na kitu, hata alicho nacho kitachukuliwa kutoka kwake.
sw.R: Watu walio na kitu watapewa zaidi, nao watakuwa na zaidi ya wanachohitaji. Lakini watu wasio na kitu watapoteza hata kile kidogo walicho nacho.

vi.L: Vì ai có, sẽ được ban cho [thêm], và sẽ được dư dật; nhưng ai không có, thì ngay cả điều người ấy có cũng sẽ bị lấy đi.
vi.B: Vì ai đã có sẽ được cho thêm, và sẽ có dư dật. Còn ai không có, thì ngay cả cái mình đang có cũng sẽ bị lấy mất.
vi.R: Ai đã có sẽ được cho thêm, và họ sẽ có nhiều hơn mức họ cần. Còn ai không có gì, thì ngay cả một chút ít họ đang có cũng sẽ bị lấy đi.

ko.L: 누구든지 가진 사람은 [더] 받아서 넘치게 될 것이고, 가지지 않은 사람은 가진 것마저 빼앗길 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 가진 사람은 누구나 더 받아서 넉넉해질 것이고, 가지지 못한 사람은 가진 것마저 빼앗길 것이다.
ko.R: 무엇이든 가진 사람은 더 받게 되고, 필요한 것보다 더 많이 가지게 된다. 그러나 아무것도 갖지 못한 사람은 그나마 가진 조금마저 빼앗기게 된다.

pt.L: Pois a todo aquele que tem, [mais] será dado, e ele terá em abundância; mas daquele que não tem, até o que tem será tirado dele.
pt.B: Pois a quem tem será dado mais, e terá mais do que o suficiente. Mas quem não tem perderá até o que tem.
pt.R: As pessoas que têm alguma coisa vão receber mais, e vão ter mais do que precisam. Mas as pessoas que não têm nada vão perder até o pouco que têm.

am.L: ላለው ሁሉ [ተጨማሪ] ይሰጠዋልና፤ ይትረፈረፍለታልም፤ ከሌለው ግን ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።
am.B: ላለው ሁሉ ይጨመርለታልና፤ ከበቂ በላይም ይኖረዋል። የሌለው ግን ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።
am.R: አንድ ነገር ላላቸው ሰዎች ተጨማሪ ይሰጣቸዋል፤ ከሚያስፈልጋቸውም በላይ ይኖራቸዋል። ምንም የሌላቸው ግን ያላቸው ትንሽ ነገር እንኳ ይወሰድባቸዋል።

ru.L: Ведь всякому имеющему будет дано, и он будет иметь в избытке; у неимеющего же и то, что имеет, будет отнято у него.
ru.B: Ведь каждому, у кого есть, дано будет ещё, и у него будет больше чем достаточно. А у того, у кого нет, отнимут даже то, что у него есть.
ru.R: Кто имеет, тем будет дано ещё, и у них будет больше, чем им нужно. А у кого ничего нет, у тех заберут даже то немногое, что у них есть.

hi.L: क्योंकि हर एक जिसके पास है, उसे [और] दिया जाएगा, और उसके पास बहुतायत होगी; पर जिसके पास नहीं है, उससे वह भी जो उसके पास है ले लिया जाएगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि जिसके पास है, उसे और दिया जाएगा, और उसके पास बहुत हो जाएगा। पर जिसके पास कुछ नहीं है, उससे वह भी ले लिया जाएगा जो उसके पास है।
hi.R: जिन लोगों के पास कुछ है, उन्हें और दिया जाएगा, और उनके पास ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा होगा। पर जिनके पास कुछ नहीं है, उनसे वह थोड़ा भी ले लिया जाएगा जो उनके पास है।

uk.L: Бо кожному, хто має, буде дано, і [той] матиме надлишок; а в того, хто не має, буде забрано й те, що має.
uk.B: Бо кожен, хто має, отримає ще, і матиме з надлишком. А хто не має нічого, втратить і те, що має.
uk.R: Людям, які щось мають, дадуть іще, і вони матимуть більше, ніж їм потрібно. А люди, які нічого не мають, утратять навіть те мале, що мають.

ja.L: 持っている者はだれでも、[さらに]与えられて、ありあまるようになる。しかし、持っていない者は、持っているものまでも取り上げられるからである。
ja.B: 持っている人はだれでも、さらに与えられて、豊かになる。しかし、持っていない人は、持っているものまで失うことになる。
ja.R: すでに何かを持っている人は、もっと与えられる。あまるほどになる。しかし、何も持っていない人は、持っているわずかなものまで失ってしまう。

decisions.choice: to everyone who has, more will be given: the saying of 13:12
decisions.reason: Jesus used the same saying of those who receive his teaching (13:12). Those who use what God gives receive more; those who neglect it lose even that.

decisions.choice: will be given, will be taken: God's action in the judgment
decisions.reason: The passives point to the judgment the parable describes.

decisions.choice: {{gender:they|he}}
decisions.reason: The saying applies to anyone, so the inclusive form is the default. Readable uses the plural.

decisions.choice: the little they have
decisions.reason: Readable says that what is taken is small, as the one talent was beside ten.

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "they|he" for the person who has. Spanish "el que tiene", "tendrá" and "se le quitará" have no pronoun that differs between an inclusive and a traditional wording, so no setting applies.

decisions.choice: "quiconque", "celui qui ... il", with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span on the pronouns, as the English
decisions.reason: As in Luke 19:26: "quiconque" and "celui qui" already mean anyone in French, and the "il" that refers back to them is ordinary generic French, so French needs no setting where the English needs one.

decisions.choice: no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "they|he" for the person who has. Swahili "naye", "alicho nacho" and "kwake" already mean he or she, so no setting applies.

decisions.choice: "ai ... người ấy", "mình", "họ", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai", "người ấy" and "mình" already include men and women (style guide, section 7), so the English they/he setting has no counterpart; the saying keeps the wording of 13:12.

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 13:12, whose saying this repeats (meaning decision): Korean says "사람" and needs no pronoun, so the English spans have nothing to change. Literal brackets "더" (more) as the English does.

decisions.choice: todo aquele que tem ... ele (L); quem tem (B), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "they" and "he". Portuguese "todo aquele que" and "quem" already mean anyone, and the "ele" that refers back to them is ordinary generic Portuguese (style §7), so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "ላለው ሁሉ ... ይሰጠዋል" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span with the plural "ላላቸው ሁሉ ... ይሰጣቸዋል" as default
decisions.reason: The English gives "they" by default for the Greek "he". In Amharic the third person singular after "everyone" ("ላለው ሁሉ") already speaks of anyone, man or woman, so there is no second wording for the setting to offer; Readable uses the plural "people" as the English does.

decisions.choice: "всякому... он", "каждому... у него", with no gender span
decisions.reason: After "всякий" and "каждый" the Russian masculine pronoun is the ordinary way to speak of anyone, and readers hear it as including women, so it takes no span where the English has one. Readable uses the plural, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "उसे", "उसके पास", with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: The English offers "they" beside "he". Hindi's "वह", "उसे" and "उसके" are not marked for gender, and no verb here shows it, so the Hindi already says "anyone" and has nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: no gender spans
alternatives: spans on the pronouns, as in English
decisions.reason: The Ukrainian uses "кожен, хто" and "той, хто" with verbs that need no pronoun, so the sentence already speaks of anyone and the English gender spans have no Ukrainian counterpart.

decisions.choice: the wording of 13:12 at each level; "者", "人" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The saying is the one of 13:12 (m1), so each level uses its wording there. Japanese "者" and "人" already include men and women and need no pronoun, so the English gender spans have no Japanese span, as in 13:12.

source.text: καὶ τὸν ἀχρεῖον δοῦλον ἐκβάλετε εἰς τὸ σκότος τὸ ἐξώτερον· ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων.

records.literal_gloss: And the worthless slave cast out into the darkness the outer; there will be the weeping and the gnashing of the teeth.

en.L: And throw the worthless slave into the outer darkness; there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'
en.B: Throw this useless servant out into the darkness outside, where people will weep and grind their teeth.'
en.R: Throw this useless servant outside into the dark. There people will cry and grind their teeth.'

es.L: Y al esclavo inútil {{plural_you:échenlo|echadlo}} a las tinieblas de afuera; allí estará el llanto y el rechinar de los dientes”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Echen|Echad}} a este siervo inútil afuera, a la oscuridad, donde la gente llorará y rechinará los dientes”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Echen|Echad}} afuera, a la oscuridad, a este siervo que no sirve para nada. Allí la gente llorará y rechinará los dientes”.

fr.L: Et l’esclave inutile, jetez-[le] dans les ténèbres du dehors ; là il y aura les pleurs et les grincements de dents.”
fr.B: Jetez ce serviteur inutile dehors, dans les ténèbres, là où l’on pleurera et grincera des dents.”
fr.R: Jetez ce serviteur bon à rien dehors, dans le noir. Là, les gens pleureront et grinceront des dents.”

sw.L: Na mtumwa huyo asiye na manufaa mtupeni ndani ya giza la nje; huko kutakuwa na kulia na kusaga meno.'
sw.B: Mtupeni mtumishi huyu asiyefaa nje gizani, mahali ambapo watu watalia na kusaga meno.'
sw.R: Mtupeni nje gizani mtumishi huyu asiyefaa kitu. Huko watu watalia na kusaga meno.'

vi.L: Và hãy ném nô lệ vô dụng kia ra chỗ tối tăm bên ngoài; ở đó sẽ có khóc lóc và nghiến răng.'
vi.B: Hãy ném tên đầy tớ vô dụng này ra chỗ tối tăm bên ngoài, là nơi người ta sẽ khóc lóc và nghiến răng.'
vi.R: Hãy ném tên đầy tớ vô dụng này ra ngoài, vào chỗ tối tăm. Ở đó người ta sẽ khóc lóc và nghiến răng.'

ko.L: 그리고 이 쓸모없는 종을 바깥의 어둠 속으로 내던져라. 거기에는 울음과 이를 가는 일이 있을 것이다.'
ko.B: 이 쓸모없는 종을 바깥 어둠 속으로 내쫓아라. 거기서 그는 울며 이를 갈 것이다.'
ko.R: 이 쓸모없는 종을 밖의 어둠 속으로 내던져라. 거기서 사람들은 울며 이를 갈 것이다.'

pt.L: E lancem o escravo inútil nas trevas exteriores; ali haverá o choro e o ranger de dentes.'
pt.B: Joguem esse servo inútil lá fora, na escuridão, onde haverá choro e ranger de dentes.'
pt.R: Joguem esse servo inútil lá fora, no escuro. Ali as pessoas vão chorar e ranger os dentes.'

am.L: የማይጠቅመውንም ባሪያ ወደ ውጭው ጨለማ አውጥታችሁ ጣሉት፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።”

decisions.choice: the outer darkness, weeping and gnashing of teeth: exclusion and anguish
alternatives: a literal place described in detail
decisions.reason: As in 8:12, the darkness outside the lighted feast pictures being shut out of the kingdom, and grinding the teeth shows anguish and rage. The wording follows 8:12 at each level.

decisions.choice: worthless: of no use to his master
decisions.reason: The word means unprofitable. The slave brought his master nothing.

decisions.choice: there will be weeping: the parable's words point beyond the story
alternatives: only the master's words in the story
decisions.reason: The phrase is Jesus's own way of speaking of the final judgment (13:42; 24:51), so the master's sentence turns into a warning to the hearers.

decisions.choice: useless
decisions.reason: "Useless" says plainly what the slave was to his master.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: "chỗ tối tăm bên ngoài"; "khóc lóc và nghiến răng"
decisions.reason: The words of 8:12 and 22:13, so the end of the parable is heard as the same judgment.

decisions.choice: "바깥의 어둠 ... 울음과 이를 가는 일" (L); "바깥 어둠 ... 울며 이를 갈다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same words as the Korean Matthew 8:12, 22:13 and 24:51.

decisions.choice: "негодного" (L); "никчёмного" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly that the slave was of no use to his master.

decisions.choice: "そこには泣くことと歯ぎしりとがあるであろう" (L); "そこで人々は泣きわめき、歯ぎしりをするだろう" (B); "そこで人々は、泣きわめいて歯ぎしりをする" (R); "外の闇" (L, B), "外の暗闇" (R)
decisions.reason: Matthew's recurring phrase for exclusion and anguish (m1, m3) takes the wording of 13:42 at each level, and the outer darkness the wording of 8:12.
